dua_sayyidul_istighfar.name: Sayyidul Istighfar (The Master of Forgiveness)
dua_sayyidul_istighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and confess my sin. Forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

dua_anxiety.name: Dua for Anxiety and Sorrow
dua_anxiety.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by people.

dua_travel.name: Dua for Travel
dua_travel.translation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, though we could never have controlled it by our own efforts. Surely, to our Lord we will return.

dua_waking_up.name: Dua Upon Waking Up
dua_waking_up.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

dua_morning.name: Morning Remembrance
dua_morning.translation: We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.

dua_after_fajr.name: Dua After Fajr
dua_after_fajr.translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.

dua_suhoor.name: Intention for Fasting
dua_suhoor.translation: I intend to keep the fast for tomorrow in the month of Ramadan.

dua_protection.name: Dua for Protection
dua_protection.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

dua_guidance_to_the_straight_path.name: Guidance to the Straight Path
dua_guidance_to_the_straight_path.translation: Guide us to the straight path.

dua_good_in_this_world_and_the_hereafter.name: Good in This World and the Hereafter
dua_good_in_this_world_and_the_hereafter.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua_acceptance_of_good_deeds.name: Acceptance of Good Deeds
dua_acceptance_of_good_deeds.translation: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

dua_submission_and_repentance.name: Submission and Repentance
dua_submission_and_repentance.translation: Our Lord, make us submissive to You and from our descendants a community submissive to You. Show us our rites and accept our repentance. You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

dua_patience_and_firmness.name: Patience and Firmness
dua_patience_and_firmness.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience, make our feet firm, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.

dua_no_burden_beyond_capacity.name: No Burden Beyond Capacity
dua_no_burden_beyond_capacity.translation: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Do not place on us a burden like that placed on those before us. Do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us.

dua_steadfast_hearts.name: Steadfast Hearts
dua_steadfast_hearts.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Bestower.

dua_forgiveness_and_protection_from_fire.name: Forgiveness and Protection from Fire
dua_forgiveness_and_protection_from_fire.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua_forgiveness_and_steadfastness.name: Forgiveness and Steadfastness
dua_forgiveness_and_steadfastness.translation: Our Lord, forgive our sins and excesses, make our feet firm, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.

dua_creation_and_protection_from_fire.name: Creation and Protection from Fire
dua_creation_and_protection_from_fire.translation: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. Glory be to You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dua_forgiveness_and_a_righteous_death.name: Forgiveness and a Righteous Death
dua_forgiveness_and_a_righteous_death.translation: Our Lord, forgive our sins, erase our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.

dua_promise_of_the_hereafter.name: Promise of the Hereafter
dua_promise_of_the_hereafter.translation: Our Lord, grant us what You promised through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You never break Your promise.

dua_dua_of_adam_and_hawwa.name: Dua of Adam and Hawwa
dua_dua_of_adam_and_hawwa.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

dua_patience_and_a_muslim_death.name: Patience and a Muslim Death
dua_patience_and_a_muslim_death.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims.

dua_dua_of_nuh_for_forgiveness.name: Dua of Nuh for Forgiveness
dua_dua_of_nuh_for_forgiveness.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking about that of which I have no knowledge. Unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be among the losers.

dua_dua_of_yusuf_for_a_muslim_death.name: Dua of Yusuf for a Muslim Death
dua_dua_of_yusuf_for_a_muslim_death.translation: My Lord, You have granted me authority and taught me the interpretation of events. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my Protector in this world and the Hereafter. Let me die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_a_secure_city.name: Dua of Ibrahim for a Secure City
dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_a_secure_city.translation: My Lord, make this city secure and keep me and my children away from worshipping idols.

dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_prayer.name: Dua of Ibrahim for Prayer
dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_prayer.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and also from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

dua_forgiveness_for_parents_and_believer.name: Forgiveness for Parents and Believers
dua_forgiveness_for_parents_and_believer.translation: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the account is established.

dua_mercy_for_parents.name: Mercy for Parents
dua_mercy_for_parents.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

dua_dua_of_the_young_believers.name: Dua of the Young Believers
dua_dua_of_the_young_believers.translation: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us rightly through our affair.

dua_dua_of_musa_for_ease_and_eloquence.name: Dua of Musa for Ease and Eloquence
dua_dua_of_musa_for_ease_and_eloquence.translation: My Lord, expand my chest, ease my task, and untie the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech.

dua_increase_me_in_knowledge.name: Increase Me in Knowledge
dua_increase_me_in_knowledge.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

dua_dua_of_ayyub_in_illness.name: Dua of Ayyub in Illness
dua_dua_of_ayyub_in_illness.translation: Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

dua_dua_of_yunus_in_distress.name: Dua of Yunus in Distress
dua_dua_of_yunus_in_distress.translation: There is no deity except You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.

dua_dua_of_zakariyya_for_an_heir.name: Dua of Zakariyya for an Heir
dua_dua_of_zakariyya_for_an_heir.translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone, though You are the best of inheritors.

dua_protection_from_devils.name: Protection from Devils
dua_protection_from_devils.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence.

dua_forgiveness_and_mercy.name: Forgiveness and Mercy
dua_forgiveness_and_mercy.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.

dua_righteous_spouses_and_children.name: Righteous Spouses and Children
dua_righteous_spouses_and_children.translation: Our Lord, grant us comfort in our spouses and children and make us examples for the mindful.

dua_dua_of_musa_for_help.name: Dua of Musa for Help
dua_dua_of_musa_for_help.translation: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.

dua_dua_of_sulayman_for_gratitude.name: Dua of Sulayman for Gratitude
dua_dua_of_sulayman_for_gratitude.translation: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor upon me and my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You.

dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_wisdom.name: Dua of Ibrahim for Wisdom
dua_dua_of_ibrahim_for_wisdom.translation: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.

dua_trust_in_allah.name: Trust in Allah
dua_trust_in_allah.translation: Our Lord, upon You we rely, to You we turn, and to You is the final return.

dua_light_and_forgiveness.name: Light and Forgiveness
dua_light_and_forgiveness.translation: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. You are able to do all things.

dua_dua_of_nuh_for_believers.name: Dua of Nuh for Believers
dua_dua_of_nuh_for_believers.translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and all believing men and women.

dua_before_sleeping.name: Before Sleeping
dua_before_sleeping.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

dua_before_entering_the_restroom.name: Before Entering the Restroom
dua_before_entering_the_restroom.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.

dua_leaving_the_home.name: Leaving the Home
dua_leaving_the_home.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might or power except through Allah.

dua_entering_the_mosque.name: Entering the Mosque
dua_entering_the_mosque.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

dua_leaving_the_mosque.name: Leaving the Mosque
dua_leaving_the_mosque.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

dua_after_the_adhan.name: After the Adhan
dua_after_the_adhan.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and distinction, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.

dua_opening_supplication_in_prayer.name: Opening Supplication in Prayer
dua_opening_supplication_in_prayer.translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You distanced East from West. Cleanse me of sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains, and wash my sins with snow, water, and hail.

dua_between_the_two_prostrations.name: Between the Two Prostrations
dua_between_the_two_prostrations.translation: My Lord, forgive me; my Lord, forgive me.

dua_help_me_worship_you_well.name: Help Me Worship You Well
dua_help_me_worship_you_well.translation: O Allah, help me remember You, thank You, and worship You well.

dua_protection_from_four_trials.name: Protection from Four Trials
dua_protection_from_four_trials.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave and Hell, the trials of life and death, and the evil trial of the False Messiah.

dua_for_guidance_piety_chastity_and_suff.name: For Guidance, Piety, Chastity, and Sufficiency
dua_for_guidance_piety_chastity_and_suff.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

dua_for_forgiveness_mercy_guidance_healt.name: For Forgiveness, Mercy, Guidance, Health, and Provision
dua_for_forgiveness_mercy_guidance_healt.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

dua_for_beneficial_knowledge_and_accepte.name: For Beneficial Knowledge and Accepted Deeds
dua_for_beneficial_knowledge_and_accepte.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

dua_the_quran_as_spring_of_the_heart.name: The Quran as Spring of the Heart
dua_the_quran_as_spring_of_the_heart.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant and maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgment over me is executed and Your decree is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my sorrow, and the departure of my anxiety.

dua_protection_for_children_from_evil_ey.name: Protection for Children from Evil Eye
dua_protection_for_children_from_evil_ey.translation: I seek protection for you both in Allah’s perfect words from every devil, harmful creature, and evil eye.

dua_visiting_the_sick.name: Visiting the Sick
dua_visiting_the_sick.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.

dua_for_healing.name: For Healing
dua_for_healing.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal. You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no sickness.

dua_when_afflicted_by_calamity.name: When Afflicted by Calamity
dua_when_afflicted_by_calamity.translation: We belong to Allah and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

dua_after_eating.name: After Eating
dua_after_eating.translation: Praise is to Allah who fed me this and provided it without any power or ability from me.

dua_breaking_the_fast.name: Breaking the Fast
dua_breaking_the_fast.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

dua_upon_seeing_the_new_moon.name: Upon Seeing the New Moon
dua_upon_seeing_the_new_moon.translation: O Allah, bring it over us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

dua_during_strong_wind.name: During Strong Wind
dua_during_strong_wind.translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it, and the good for which it was sent. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it, and the evil for which it was sent.

dua_for_rain.name: For Rain
dua_for_rain.translation: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.

dua_entering_a_marketplace.name: Entering a Marketplace
dua_entering_a_marketplace.translation: None is worthy of worship but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise. He gives life and causes death. He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is able to do all things.

dua_expiation_of_a_gathering.name: Expiation of a Gathering
dua_expiation_of_a_gathering.translation: Glory and praise are Yours, O Allah. I testify that none is worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

dua_for_protection_from_harm.name: For Protection from Harm
dua_for_protection_from_harm.translation: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He created.

dua_contentment_with_allah_islam_and_muh.name: Contentment with Allah, Islam, and Muhammad
dua_contentment_with_allah_islam_and_muh.translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as Prophet.

dua_for_well_being_in_both_worlds.name: For Well-Being in Both Worlds
dua_for_well_being_in_both_worlds.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
dua_for_well_being_in_both_worlds.reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 3871; Sunan Abi Dawud 5074

dua_do_not_leave_me_to_myself.name: Do Not Leave Me to Myself
dua_do_not_leave_me_to_myself.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

dua_for_paradise_and_protection_from_fir.name: For Paradise and Protection from Fire
dua_for_paradise_and_protection_from_fir.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
dua_for_paradise_and_protection_from_fir.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 792; Sunan Ibn Majah 910

dua_istikhara.name: Dua of Istikhara
dua_istikhara.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge and seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. You are capable and I am not; You know and I do not; You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter is good for my religion, livelihood and outcome, decree it for me, make it easy and bless it for me. If You know it is harmful for my religion, livelihood and outcome, turn it away from me and turn me away from it. Decree good for me wherever it may be, then make me content with it.

dua_laylatul_qadr.name: Dua for Laylat al-Qadr
dua_laylatul_qadr.translation: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

dua_qunut_witr.name: Qunut of Witr
dua_qunut_witr.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided; grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being; take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care; bless what You have given me; and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. You decree and none decrees over You. The one You befriend is never disgraced. Blessed and Exalted are You, our Lord.

dua_after_wudu.name: Dua After Ablution
dua_after_wudu.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

dua_entering_home.name: Dua When Entering the Home
dua_entering_home.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

dua_wearing_garment.name: Dua When Wearing a Garment
dua_wearing_garment.translation: Praise is to Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or ability from me.

dua_new_garment.name: Dua When Wearing New Clothes
dua_new_garment.translation: O Allah, praise is Yours. You clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.

dua_before_intimacy.name: Dua Before Marital Relations
dua_before_intimacy.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from what You grant us.

dua_for_righteous_child.name: Dua for Righteous Offspring
dua_for_righteous_child.translation: My Lord, grant me offspring from among the righteous.

dua_debt_sufficiency.name: Dua for Halal Sufficiency and Debt Relief
dua_debt_sufficiency.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent by Your bounty from everyone besides You.

dua_difficult_matter.name: Dua When a Matter Is Difficult
dua_difficult_matter.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make difficulty easy if You will.
dua_difficult_matter.reference: Sahih Ibn Hibban 974; authenticated by al-Albani

dua_anger.name: Dua When Angry
dua_anger.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

dua_bad_dream.name: Dua After a Bad Dream
dua_bad_dream.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan and from the evil of what I saw.

dua_visiting_graves.name: Dua When Visiting Graves
dua_visiting_graves.translation: Peace be upon you, inhabitants of these dwellings, believers and Muslims. We will, if Allah wills, join you. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

dua_funeral_deceased.name: Dua for the Deceased
dua_funeral_deceased.translation: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honour his reception, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains.

dua_condolence.name: Words of Condolence
dua_condolence.translation: To Allah belongs what He took and what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term. So be patient and seek reward from Allah.

dua_thunder.name: Remembrance Upon Hearing Thunder
dua_thunder.translation: Glory is to Him whom thunder glorifies with praise, and the angels glorify out of fear of Him.
dua_thunder.reference: Al-Muwatta 2/992; authenticated as a statement of Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr

dua_rain_around_us.name: Dua When Rain Becomes Excessive
dua_rain_around_us.translation: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us; upon the hills, small mountains, valleys and places where trees grow.

dua_protection_dajjal.name: Protection from the Dajjal and Major Trials
dua_protection_dajjal.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave, the trials of life and death, and the evil trial of the False Messiah.

dua_all_good.name: Comprehensive Dua for All Good
dua_all_good.translation: O Allah, I ask You for every good, immediate and delayed, known to me and unknown to me; and I seek refuge in You from every evil, immediate and delayed, known to me and unknown to me.
dua_all_good.reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 3846; authenticated by al-Albani

dua_steadfast_heart.name: Dua for Steadfastness of the Heart
dua_steadfast_heart.translation: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

dua_good_character.name: Dua for Good Character
dua_good_character.translation: O Allah, guide me to the best character, for none can guide to it except You; and turn bad character away from me, for none can turn it away except You.

dua_light.name: Dua for Light
dua_light.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, sight and hearing; place light on my right and left, above and below me, before and behind me; and grant me light.
